title: Elderly Woman Holding Baby in Kitchen, 1940s Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: An older woman, likely a grandmother wearing spectacles and a floral dress, holds an infant swaddled in white clothing and a bonnet inside a kitchen. In the background stands a vintage domestic refrigerator with an exterior latch mechanism and a stove with a cast iron skillet resting on top. Intense ambient daylight streams across the subjects, imparting high contrast and an intimate slice of early-to-mid 20th-century domestic life.
